units.source_text: 有一天，匂亲王回来了。

en.t: One day, Prince Niou returned.

units.source_text: 常陆守夫人很想看看，便从缝隙中窥探，

en.t: The wife of the Governor of Hitachi very much wanted to see him, so she peered through a gap,

units.source_text: 但见匂亲王容姿异常清丽，犹如刚才摘下来的一枝樱花。

en.t: and saw that Prince Niou was extraordinarily graceful and beautiful, like a branch of cherry blossoms freshly picked.

units.source_text: 有几个四位、五位的殿上人跪在他面前伺候。

en.t: Several courtiers of the fourth and fifth ranks knelt before him in attendance.

units.source_text: 这些殿上人，比较起虽然粗暴可恨而是她所真心信赖的丈夫常陆守来，风采、容貌和人品都优秀得多。

en.t: Compared with her husband, the Governor of Hitachi, who was rough and hateful yet truly trusted by her, these courtiers were far superior in bearing, appearance, and character.

units.source_text: 一群家臣一一向他申报各种事务。

en.t: A group of retainers reported various matters to him one by one.

units.source_text: 又有许多年轻的五位官员，她都不认识。

en.t: There were also many young fifth-rank officials whom she did not know.

units.source_text: 她的继子式部丞兼藏人的，当了宫中的御使，也来参见。

en.t: Her stepson, who held the posts of Assistant in the Ministry of Ceremonial and Chamberlain, had come as an imperial messenger and also presented himself.

units.source_text: 她看了这位威势显赫、令人不敢迫近的匂亲王的神情，想道：“唉，何等英俊的人物啊！

en.t: Seeing Prince Niou's imposing, unapproachable presence, she thought, "Ah, what a handsome man he is!

units.source_text: 嫁得这个丈夫的人真好福气！

en.t: How fortunate must be the woman who has him for a husband!

units.source_text: 我不曾拜见他时，设想此人虽然高贵，但爱情不专，怀有二心，二女公子定多痛苦。

en.t: Before I had seen him, I imagined that although he was noble, his love was inconstant and divided, and that the Second Princess must suffer greatly.

units.source_text: 现在想来，这种推测太浅薄了。

en.t: Now that I think of it, that judgment was far too shallow.

units.source_text: 我看匂亲王的容姿，觉得倘能做他的妻室，即使只能像织女星那样一年和他相逢一度，也是莫大的幸福啊！”

en.t: Looking at Prince Niou's beauty, I feel that if one could be his wife, even meeting him only once a year like the Weaver Star would be an immense happiness!"

units.source_text: 此时但见匂亲王抱着小公子，正在逗他玩乐；二女公子隔着短屏坐着。

en.t: At that moment Prince Niou was holding the young lord and amusing him, while the Second Princess sat on the other side of a low screen.

units.source_text: 匂亲王推开短屏，和她对面谈话。

en.t: Prince Niou pushed the low screen aside and spoke with her face to face.

units.source_text: 两人容貌都很艳丽，真乃一对璧人！

en.t: Both of them were splendidly beautiful, truly a perfect pair.

units.source_text: 回想起已故八亲王的寒酸之姿，两相比较，觉得虽然同是亲王，实有天壤之别。

en.t: When she recalled the shabby appearance of the late Eighth Prince and compared the two, she felt that although both were princes, the difference between them was like heaven and earth.

units.source_text: 后来匂亲王进帐中去了，小公子就同青年侍女和乳母游戏。

en.t: Later Prince Niou went inside the curtains, and the young lord played with the young waiting women and his nurse.

units.source_text: 许多人前来请安，但匂亲王命人传言心情不佳，概不接见，一直睡到了日暮。

en.t: Many people came to pay their respects, but Prince Niou had word sent that he was unwell, received no one, and slept until dusk.

units.source_text: 这一天饮食也在这里进用。

en.t: That day he also took his meals there.

units.source_text: 浮舟的母亲看了这种光景，想道：“此间万事气象高贵，迥异寻常。

en.t: Ukifune's mother, seeing this scene, thought, "Everything here has an air of nobility, utterly unlike ordinary places.

units.source_text: 看了这种光景之后，便觉自己家里虽然力求豪华，但因人品低劣，毕竟粗率可怜。

en.t: After seeing such a scene, I feel that although my own household tries to be splendid, because the people are of poor quality it remains crude and pitiable after all.

units.source_text: 只有我的浮舟，倘能匹配此种高贵人物，毫无不称之处。

en.t: Only my Ukifune, if she were matched with such a noble person, would not be unsuitable in the least.

units.source_text: 常陆守凭仗他那丰厚的财力，一心想把他的几个亲生女儿捧得皇后一般高。

en.t: The Governor of Hitachi relies on his great wealth and is intent on raising his own daughters as high as empresses.

units.source_text: 这些女儿虽然同是我腹中生下来的，然而浮舟比她们优越得多。

en.t: Though those daughters too were born from my own womb, Ukifune is far superior to them.

units.source_text: 如此想来，今后关于浮舟的前程，不可不抱高远的志望了。”

en.t: Thinking of it this way, from now on I must hold lofty hopes for Ukifune's future."

units.source_text: 她通夜不眠地打算将来之事。

en.t: She stayed awake all night planning for the future.
